positiveEvidence.title: Prodotti Hera Mobilita / HeraRicarica Pubblica
positiveEvidence.details: A 2025 Hera-branded brochure mirrored outside gruppohera.it states A CONSUMO: EUR 2/month; AC on Hera stations EUR 0.720/kWh; AC on other providers EUR 0.720/kWh; DC and above EUR 0.850/kWh. It also states the HeraRicarica compatible network includes Hera plus Enel X, Duferco, Be Charge and Neogy and payment is billed by Hera.

negativeEvidence: Exact tariff strings from the mirrored brochure were not found on current official gruppohera.it/heracomm.gruppohera.it indexed pages during this run.
updates.decision: fail-closed: do not promote the mirrored 2025 values as current direct-CPO tariffs. The brochure is strong discovery evidence but also describes HeraRicarica as a multi-CPO service; current first-party confirmation and deterministic operator/station mapping are still required.
updates.resumeCondition: Obtain current first-party Hera tariff payload/document or app/backend response that identifies operator/station/EVSE and tariff channel; then separate direct Hera CPO price from Hera eMSP roaming prices before ranking.
updates.confidence: medium-high discovery / insufficient for current rankable promotion

history: 2026-09-15: located a 2025 Hera-branded mobility brochure mirror with explicit 0.720 EUR/kWh AC and 0.850 EUR/kWh DC+ values; retained as discovery evidence only because current first-party confirmation is missing and the same brochure covers roaming partner stations.
